briefing: Stocks rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.7% and the S&P 500 up 2.3%. Our past lessons say to put spare cash to work on strong up days like this, so we're using the remaining ~$446 to buy VSAT, the one candidate showing every buy signal including heavy trading volume. All seven existing positions stay as they are, and their automatic stop-losses and profit targets remain in place.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like tech and growth stocks, which pushes indexes such as the NASDAQ sharply higher. Days like this are often a good time to put idle cash to work, but you should still pick stocks backed by several confirming signals, such as heavy trading volume, rather than buying anything that's going up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）指投資者信心充足，將資金轉投科技股、增長股等較高風險資產，帶動納指等指數顯著上揚。這類交易日往往是動用閒置現金的好時機，但仍應挑選有多重訊號確認的股份，例如成交量明顯放大，而非盲目追捧所有上漲股票。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rallied broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ up 2.7% and the S&P 500 up 2.3%, a classic risk-on session where investors favor growth and higher-risk names. The strength was widespread across semiconductors (AMD, MPWR, ALAB), satellite and space stocks (VSAT, ASTS) and infrastructure builders (STRL), with many screened stocks breaking above their 20-day averages. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation is based only on price and volume behavior, not on a specific news catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面走高，以科技股為主的納指急升2.7%，標普500指數亦漲2.3%，屬典型的「風險偏好」交易日，資金明顯流向增長股及高風險板塊。升勢遍及半導體（AMD、MPWR、ALAB）、衛星及太空概念股（VSAT、ASTS）以及基建股（STRL），多隻篩選股份更突破20日均線。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，以上分析純粹基於價量表現，並非源自特定消息催化。

trades.reasoning: VSAT is the only top-scoring candidate with all four signals we want before a high-conviction buy: MACD crossover, RSI 64.4 (below overbought), price well above its 20-day average, and a volume surge, on a strong risk-on day.
